label: Claude Pro
models: Claude Fable (via paid usage credits only)
limits: "Every plan has usage limits that reset on a rolling five-hour session window, and paid plans add weekly limits on top." "Pro gives you at least 5x more usage per 5-hour session than Free." "Your activity across Claude on web, desktop, mobile, and Claude Code all draws from the same pool."
notes: Annual: $200 billed up front ($17/mo). Claude Code docs say OAuth is 'designed to support ordinary use of Claude Code and other native Anthropic applications', and 'Anthropic does not permit third-party developers to offer Claude.ai login into their own applications, or to route requests through Free, Pro, or Max plan credentials'. Usage credits (overage) are available on paid plans. The pricing page shows Fable as 'Usage credits' for Pro, meaning it isn't covered by the included allowance.

label: Claude Max 5x
models: Claude Fable (capped at 50% of weekly limits)
limits: "Max gives you 5x or 20x more usage per 5-hour session than Pro." Help center: "five times the Pro plan's per-session usage allowance"; "Your session-based usage limit will reset every five hours." "Max plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models." Fable: "50% of weekly limits*".
notes: Billed monthly only. Includes $100/month in Claude Platform API credits (pricing page: '$100 to $200/month in API credits'; table: Max 5x $100/month). Account for these in value calculations: API credits can be spent from any harness via an API key. Mobile pricing may differ. Same third-party OAuth restriction as Pro.

label: Claude Max 20x
models: Claude Fable (capped at 50% of weekly limits)
limits: Help center: "20 times the Pro plan's per-session usage allowance"; "Your session-based usage limit will reset every five hours." "Max plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models." Fable: "50% of weekly limits*".
notes: The pricing page shows only 'From $100' for Max. The $200 figure comes from the help center article ('Updated this week'). Includes $200/month in Claude Platform API credits per the pricing table. Monthly billing only. No newer individual tier above Max 20x was found. Mythos appears in site nav but isn't listed in any plan's model table.

label: ChatGPT Go
limits: "GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app, subject to rollout"; "Use Codex for lightweight coding tasks." No numeric limits published.
notes: No Codex CLI or IDE extension: the feature table lists those for Plus and above. Sign in with ChatGPT plan usage is documented for 'eligible ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers' only, so Go probably can't power third-party harnesses.

label: ChatGPT Plus
limits: Local messages per five-hour period (estimates, 'not fixed message limits'): GPT-6 Astra 5-45, GPT-6.1 Sol 15-160, GPT-6 Sol 15-150, GPT-6 Luna 350-3,000. "Local messages and cloud chats share your plan's usage allowance. Weekly limits may also apply." Fast mode uses included usage at 2.5x.
notes: Third-party use is officially supported through 'Sign in with ChatGPT': 'eligible ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers can also choose to use their ChatGPT plan for AI requests'. The listed open-source integrations are OpenClaw, OpenCode, Pi and T3. App usage 'counts toward your existing plan limits', and per-app weekly caps can be set. The pricing page table marks GPT-6 Astra as available on Plus; the model list on the plan card names only GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. GPT-5.5 retired from ChatGPT-sign-in Codex on 2026-10-14. Overage via ChatGPT credits. No annual price could be verified (chatgpt.com/pricing returns 403 to scripted fetches).

label: ChatGPT Pro 100
limits: "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." Help center: "Pro 200 includes more usage than Pro 100." Weekly limits apply. At launch (2026-04-09) OpenAI said: "Pro $100 unlocks 5x higher usage than Plus" (secondary report of the launch statement).
notes: Price is primary. The 5x-Plus multiplier is from the April 2026 launch coverage (secondary), and the current help center doesn't restate it. The help center was read via the r.jina.ai reader because help.openai.com returns 403 to direct fetches. The help center says 'Pro use is subject to our Terms of Use. Sharing account credentials, reselling access and automatically extracting data are prohibited.'

label: ChatGPT Pro 200
limits: "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." "Pro 200 includes more usage than Pro 100." "New subscriptions that aren't eligible for grandfathering include a lower usage allowance than previously offered with Pro 200."
notes: Allowance was cut on 2026-09-29. Subscribers active between 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-29 keep the old allowance (previously advertised as 20x Plus) through 2026-10-29. Secondary sources describe the new allowance as roughly half the old value, but OpenAI publishes no multiplier. Treat the multiplier as unknown.

label: ChatGPT Pro 500
limits: "Pro 500 offers the highest included usage of the three plans." "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." Ultrafast "uses your plan's included usage first at 8x the Standard rate for the selected model, then draws from your credit balance at 6x the Standard credit rate".
notes: Launched 2026-09-29. No usage multiplier relative to Plus is published.

label: Google AI Pro
limits: "Get 4x higher usage access than Free"; Antigravity: "Entry rate limits to agent model in Google Antigravity"; Antigravity docs: "A high, generous quota, refreshed every five hours until the weekly limit is reached" / "A higher weekly rate limit"; overage via purchased AI credits "consumed at standard Gemini Enterprise consumption pricing". No numeric quota published.
notes: Price is primary (gemini.google). Gemini CLI: banner says 'Unpaid tier and Google One users: Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on June 18th, 2026', but the body of the same page still lists the old quota of 1,500 requests/day for AI Pro (stale). thirdPartyHarnessAllowed=false is based on secondary reports: from Feb 2026, Pro/Ultra accounts were suspended for routing Antigravity OAuth through OpenCode/OpenClaw. No official ToS clause was quoted. Antigravity docs list BYOK as unsupported. Annual price not verified. Includes $10/mo Google Cloud credits.

label: Google AI Ultra (5x)
models: third-party Model Garden models in Antigravity (e.g. Claude Sonnet)
limits: "$99.99 / month: 5x higher usage limits vs. AI Pro"; Antigravity: "Ultra 5x: Higher rate limits to agent model in Google Antigravity"; docs: "The highest, most generous quota, refreshed every five hours" / "The highest weekly rate limits" / "Access to third-party models".
notes: Google One help: 'you get 5x or 20x usage quota in Gemini and Google Antigravity compared to the Google AI Pro plan'; 'Each product has its own AI usage limits.' Secondary sources say Ultra 5x launched 2026-05-19. Includes $40/mo Cloud credits (stated for Ultra). Third-party harness: same OAuth-ban caveat as Pro.

label: Google AI Ultra (20x)
models: third-party Model Garden models in Antigravity (e.g. Claude Sonnet)
limits: "$199.99 / month: 20x higher usage limits vs. AI Pro"; Antigravity: "Ultra 20x: Highest rate limits to agent model in Google Antigravity"; refreshed every five hours up to weekly limit.
notes: Secondary sources say the price dropped from $249.99 to $199.99 on 2026-05-19. Gemini CLI's stale table says 2,000 req/day for Ultra. Same third-party caveat as Pro.

Grok API access is included but 'billed separately at standard model rates and doesn't draw from your plan's usage pool', so the pool can't be used in third-party harnesses through the API. Also bundles X Premium social features.

limits: "Higher limits and fewer interruptions", e.g. Kimi K3: 440 req/5h, $60 monthly usage; Kimi K2.7 Code 4,050 / $180; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 69,330 / $160.

label: GLM Coding Plan Lite
limits: Each plan is subject to both a 5-hour usage limit and a weekly usage limit. Lite: 2,000 5-hour credits, 10,000 weekly credits. 5-hour credits: dynamically refreshed; credit quota resets 5 hours after consumption. Weekly credits: activated upon subscription; resets every 7 days. During off-peak hours, model usage is charged at 50% of the standard credit rate (peak: Mon–Fri 14:00–18:00 UTC+8). Est. 48–104M GLM-5.3 tokens/week depending on cache hit rate.
notes: The $18 monthly price is primary (docs: 'Starting at just 18 USD per month'). The $12.60/mo annual figure is secondary: 30% yearly discount, 20% quarterly ($14.40). z.ai/subscribe renders prices client-side, so it couldn't be scraped. Since 2026-07-30 the plan bills in credits instead of prompts. FAQ: 'strictly limited to use within officially supported tools and products', with a list of about 20 tools including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Third-party use is fine within that list and forbidden outside it. ZCode and AutoClaw consume 1.5x usage. Plan quota can't be used for general API calls; from 2026-10-16 coding-plan API keys are separate keys. No refunds.

label: GLM Coding Plan Pro
limits: Pro: 12,000 5-hour credits, 60,000 weekly credits (same reset and off-peak rules as Lite). Est. 290–627M GLM-5.3 tokens/week.
notes: Credit limits are primary. The $80 price is secondary: the official 2026-04-21 Legacy Plan Migration Notice still shows $72 for the old prompt-based plan, and third parties report the live subscribe page shows $80 for the credit plan. Annual $56/mo is secondary. Supported-tools-only restriction as for Lite.

label: GLM Coding Plan Max
limits: Max: 28,000 5-hour credits, 140,000 weekly credits. Est. 676–1,463M GLM-5.3 tokens/week.
notes: The $168 price is secondary; the legacy prompt plan was $160 per the official migration notice. Credit limits are primary.

notes: Help center prices were captured 2026-10-12: $19/mo, or $180/yr ($15/mo). The credit pool is shared with Kimi web features (Work, Deep Research, slides, Claw). The docs say: 'Please maintain the tool's real identity identifier... Tampering with the client identifier (User-Agent) is considered a violation.' Legacy tiers (Moderato and others) keep weekly limits. China CNY plans (Go ¥49 with no coding, Plus ¥99, Pro ¥199, Max ¥699) are secondary only and not included. Extra Usage is pay-as-you-go near API rates.

label: Kimi Pro
limits: Rolling 5-hour Kimi Code limit, no weekly limit, monthly shared credit pool ('More credits, Goal Mode, and a dedicated Kimi Claw').
notes: $372/yr. Secondary sources say plan cards show credits as 2x Plus. Same User-Agent rule as Plus.

notes: $948/yr. Secondary sources say 5x Plus credits.

'Using mimo-v2.6-flash as the baseline, it can execute approximately 200 rounds of medium-to-complex tasks.' v2.6-pro: 300 credits/input token (cache miss), 2.5 cached, 600 output. 'When the monthly total quota of your plan is used up, the system will suspend the service.' Off-peak (00:00–08:00 Beijing) 0.8x.
notes: ¥39/mo. Annual: $63.36/yr (¥411.84). Monthly quota only, with no 5-hour or weekly window in the docs. 12% first-purchase discount. No refunds. Xiaomi documents integrations for several third-party tools and I found no supported-tools-only clause, but I didn't read the full ToS.

limits: Fixed Monthly Quota: 11 billion Credits (~1,600 rounds of medium-to-complex tasks on v2.6-flash).

Separate Subscription Key; pay-as-you-go keys aren't interchangeable.
